scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
I think we're really
fortunate to be able to
live in such a beautiful
and peaceful city like this.
scripts.translation:
[智元]
我觉得我们真的很幸运，能够生活在这样一个美丽而宁静的城市里。

scripts.text:
[Jiwon]
It's just so nice to
have this pleasant weather,
these lush gardens and to
meet all of these kind people.
Lighthalzen is like Asgard
in Midgard, heaven on earth~
scripts.translation:
[智元]
宜人的天气、郁郁葱葱的花园，还有这些善良的人们，一切都太美好了。里希塔乐镇简直就是米德加尔特中的阿斯加德，人间天堂呀~

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
It gets harder for me
to move around as I get
older. That's understandable
for an elderly person, right?
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
年纪大了，行动越来越不便了。这对老年人来说也是理所当然的吧？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
Just the other day, these
hoodlums in black suits
were yelling at me to get out
of their way. But of course,
I didn't move quickly enough.
So what did they do to me?
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
就在前几天，那几个穿黑西装的小混混冲我大喊大叫，让我让路。当然，我动作没那么快。结果他们对我做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Samnang]
They punched me.
Right in the womb!
I know that I'm not
pregnant, but that's
besides the point. Never hit
a lady, especially an old one!
scripts.translation:
[萨姆南]
他们打了我一拳。
正打在肚子上！
我知道我没怀孕，但这不是重点。永远不要打女士，尤其是老女士！

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
Sweety, isn't it
nice to be together
under this beautiful
sunlight? It's perfect
for our date. Ahhhh~
scripts.translation:
[露丝]
甜心，在这美丽的阳光下在一起，是不是很美好？这简直是约会的完美时刻。啊~~~

scripts.text:
[Ruth]
I'm so happy to be
with you. I feel like
I'm just melting with
happiness. Oh, I love
you so much, Oyoung.
scripts.translation:
[露丝]
和你在一起我真幸福。我感觉自己都要幸福得融化了。哦，五荣，我好爱你。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Whoa...
This couple is
really headed for
Cloud 9, aren't they?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哇……
这对情侣真是
飘飘欲仙了啊，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
Girl, you look like
you're comin' down with
the love bug. But there's
only one prescription for
this ailment, ooooh yeah...
scripts.translation:
[五荣]
姑娘，你看起来像是得了相思病。不过这种毛病只有一种处方，噢耶……

scripts.text:
[Oyoung]
You need yo'self
your daily dose of
vitamin O-YOUNG.
And your lips look like
they got vitamin deficiency.
I better take care of that~
scripts.translation:
[五荣]
你需要补充每日份的
维生素“五荣”。
而且你的嘴唇看起来缺乏维生素。
我得好好照顾一下~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sweet Sister!
I don't know what's
more mind boggling--
The fact that he used
that line or the fact that
it's actually working...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
天哪！
我不知道是他用的
这句搭讪台词更让人无语，
还是这招居然真的管用更让人无语……

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
I think ''Lighthalzen'' is
supposed to mean ''crest of
light,'' though I hear that this
city was actually named after
somebody. Who knows for sure?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
我想“里希塔乐镇”的意思应该是“光之冠”，不过我听说这座城市其实是根据某个人命名的。谁说得准呢？

scripts.text:
[Kariya]
Still, it's a fitting
name for the wealthiest
and most luxurious city in
all the Schwarzwald Republic.
So how do you like this place?
scripts.translation:
[苅谷]
不过，对于整个修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国最富裕、最奢华的城市来说，这个名字还是很贴切的。你觉得这个地方怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Sung]
When I grow up, I want
to become such a great
person that they'll make
a statue of me, just like
those statues over there.
scripts.translation:
[成]
等我长大了，我要成为一个伟大的人，让他们为我立雕像，就像那边的那些雕像一样。

scripts.text:
[Sung]
Then people would be like,
''Hey yo. That statue. That
guy must have been great!''
Just thinking about that
makes me feel so good!
scripts.translation:
[成]
然后人们就会说：“嘿哟。那个雕像。那个人一定很伟大！”光是想想就让我感觉好极了！

scripts.text:
[Sung]
That's it. I'm gonna
grow up as soon as I can.
Ooh, and I better grow tall
and handsome so my statue
will be even more awesome.
Yeah. Yeah, good idea, Sung...
scripts.translation:
[成]
就这样。我要尽快长大。
哦，我还得长得又高又帅，这样我的雕像才会更棒。
嗯。嗯，好主意，成……

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
There are too many
loving couples in this city.
Cuddling and kissing and
hugging and necking. It's...
It's utterly distasteful.
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
这个城市里恩爱的情侣太多了。
搂抱、亲吻、拥抱、亲热。真是……
真是令人厌恶。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I can't believe the
indecency I see everyday
near my own home. Don't
they know better than to be
so affectionate in places
where the public can see them?!
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
我真不敢相信在我家附近每天都能看到这种不雅的行为。
难道他们不知道在公共场合如此亲昵是不合适的吗？！

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
Fortunately for the
world, I'm a bulwark
of morality. In fact, I have
no need for a woman. All
I need are my ship models,
teen novels and dominoes.
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
幸运的是，我是道德的中流砥柱。
事实上，我不需要女人。
我只需要我的船模、青少年小说和多米诺骨牌。

scripts.text:
[Sameer]
I'm a completely well
adjusted individual, which
is why the authorities should
listen to me when I tell them
to arrest couples for indecency!
Hand holding. Have they no shame?!
scripts.translation:
[萨米尔]
我是一个完全适应良好的个体，这就是为什么当局应该听我的，逮捕那些行为不端的情侣！
牵手。他们不知羞耻吗？！

scripts.text:
[Janice]
Oh no, I think I got
lost again. The roads
here are so confusing!
I've lived here for such
a long time and I still
can't find my way around...
scripts.translation:
[珍妮丝]
哦不，我想我又迷路了。
这里的路太让人困惑了！
我在这里住了这么久，还是找不到路……

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
Walking side by side
with you like this reminds
me of the old days. Back
then, everyone was jealous
that I had such a beautiful
woman by my side. Heh heh~
scripts.translation:
[埃尔默·基斯]
像这样和你并肩散步，让我想起了过去的日子。
那时候，每个人都嫉妒我身边有这么美丽的女人。嘿嘿~

scripts.text:
[Elmer Keays]
You're still the most
precious sight to these
old eyes, my dear. I'm
really lucky to be with you.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔默·基斯]
亲爱的，在我这双老眼里，你依然是最美的风景。能和你在一起，我真的很幸运。

scripts.text:
[Margie Keays]
Oh darling, the
weather is so nice
and pleasant today.
I'm really glad we
decided to go take
a walk together~
scripts.translation:
[玛吉·基斯]
哦亲爱的，今天的天气真好，真宜人。
我很高兴我们决定一起出来散步~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
...

[Maivi]
Ah...
I just had the nicest
nap. This nice weather
never fails to relax me.
The air here is so clean,
not like that Einbroch~
scripts.translation:
[麦维]
啊……
我刚睡了个舒服的午觉。
这好天气总能让我放松。
这里的空气真干净，不像艾音布罗克~

scripts.text:
[Maivi]
This clean, pristine
environment is all thanks
to the Rekenber Corporation.
It's incredible what they can
do with technology now, isn't
it? Ahhh, it's so peaceful~
scripts.translation:
[麦维]
这干净纯净的环境全靠雷肯贝尔公司。
他们现在的技术真是了不起，不是吗？
啊，真平静~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Excuse me, but are you
a tourist? Well, welcome
to Lighthalzen! This city
has everything we need,
but it can be a little too
quiet and uneventful here.
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
打扰一下，你是游客吗？
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇！
这座城市拥有我们需要的一切，
但这里可能有点太安静、太平淡了。

scripts.text: Have you lived in here long?
scripts.translation: 你在这里住很久了吗？

scripts.text: I agree.
scripts.translation: 我同意。

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过连环杀手的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, our family has
lived in this city for a
long time, starting with
my great grandfather. Let's
see, my family's been here
for about two hundred years.
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
是的，我们家在这座城市住了很久了，从我曾祖父开始。
让我想想，我家在这里大概有两百年了。

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You'd be surprised how
many people stay in their
hometowns. Even if you do
leave, though, you can always
come back. It wouldn't be your hometown if you couldn't, right?
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
你会惊讶于有多少人留在他们的家乡。
即使你离开了，也总是可以回来的。
如果不能回来，那就不叫家乡了，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
Yes, the atmosphere
can get pretty listless
around here. But still,
there are plenty of nice
sights to enjoy here in
Lighthalzen, so look around~
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
是的，这里的气氛确实有点沉闷。
不过，里希塔乐镇还是有很多美景可以欣赏的，四处看看吧~

scripts.text:
[Klaubis]
You mean the Serial
Axe Murderer? I thought
that was an old ghost story.
Hm. I think that lady inside
the Weapon Shop would
know more about that tale...
scripts.translation:
[克劳比斯]
你是说连环斧头杀人魔？
我以为那是个古老的鬼故事。
嗯。我想武器店里的那位女士可能更了解那个传说……

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
You know what I noticed?
The guards at the border
to the slum seem distracted
sometimes. I made use of one
of their less attentive moments
and basically jumped the fence!
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
你注意到了吗？
通往贫民窟边境的卫兵有时似乎会分心。
我利用了他们不太注意的时候，基本上直接翻过了栅栏！

scripts.text:
[Sigmund Ting]
But once I was in the 
slums, I was pretty bored.
There really isn't much to
do there. Which makes me
wonder... Why guard it?
scripts.translation:
[西格蒙德·丁]
但是一旦进入贫民窟，我就觉得很无聊。
那里真的没什么可做的。
这让我想知道……为什么要守卫那里？

scripts.text:
[Joyce]
I can sense your
longing look within
the depths of my heart,
beating faster and faster
with a feverish passion~
scripts.translation:
[乔伊斯]
我能感受到你内心深处渴望的目光，
随着狂热的激情跳动得越来越快~

scripts.text:
[Dan Song]
Those eyes of yours...
So pure and so deep,
like glimmering pools
of light. So, so beautiful...
scripts.translation:
[丹·宋]
你的那双眼睛……
如此纯洁深邃，
如同闪烁的光池。
如此，如此美丽……

scripts.text:
[Collins]
I really wish that my
son will be able to join
the Rekenber Corporation.
They certainly provide the
best jobs in Lighthalzen.
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
我真希望我的儿子能加入雷肯贝尔公司。
他们确实提供了里希塔乐镇最好的工作。

scripts.text:
[Collins]
Although they're a large,
major corporation, it's
almost impossible to get
employed by them. How
do people get hired there
in the first place anyway?
scripts.translation:
[柯林斯]
虽然他们是一家大型主要企业，
但几乎不可能被他们雇佣。
人们到底是怎么被录用的呢？

scripts.text:
[Villagomez]
I just step out to get
a haircut and now I'm
lost. Boy oh boy, I hope
I don't keep my family
waiting. ^333333*Sigh...*^000000
scripts.translation:
[维拉戈梅斯]
我只是出来理个发，现在就迷路了。
哎呀，希望我不会让家人等太久。^333333*叹气...*^000000

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
Have you ever seen the
people who work in that big
corporation over there? I think
their employees are all a bit
off kilter for some reason.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
你见过在那家大公司工作的人吗？
我觉得他们的员工不知为何都有点不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Kemp]
I haven't been there
myself, but something
strange is happening with
all the people who work there.
scripts.translation:
[肯普]
我自己没去过，
但在那里工作的人都发生了一些奇怪的事情。

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
The youth in this city
have no appreciation for
their elders. I've worked
so hard to help build this
city for so many years and
this is the thanks I get?
scripts.translation:
[毛罗]
这个城市的年轻人不懂得尊重长辈。
我多年来努力工作帮助建设这座城市，
这就是我得到的回报吗？

scripts.text:
[Mauro]
Bah! If it weren't for
us, Lighthalzen wouldn't
be as prosperous as it is
today! Those kids don't
know that they owe their
lives of luxury to us...
scripts.translation:
[毛罗]
呸！如果没有我们，
里希塔乐镇就不会像今天这样繁荣！
那些孩子不知道他们的奢华生活是我们给的……

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
Good looks. Intelligence.
Excellent manners. A strong,
manly chin and overpowering,
piercing eyes. Perfectly balanced passion and charisma. All the
good things that ladies want.
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
英俊的外表。智慧。
优秀的礼仪。坚强有力的下巴和极具穿透力的眼神。
完美的激情与魅力平衡。
所有女士都想要的优点。

scripts.text:
[Sefith]
But enough about me. Let's
discuss how sorry I should
feel for any other man living
in Lighthalzen. They don't hold
a candle to my studliness~
scripts.translation:
[塞菲斯]
不过不说我了。
我们来谈谈我应该为生活在里希塔乐镇的其他男人感到多么遗憾。
他们根本比不上我的男子气概~

scripts.text:
[Jade]
I've heard that there's a
strange kingdom out there
that's basically ruled by
magic and swords, where
adventurers are enlisted
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
我听说外面有一个奇怪的王国，
基本上由魔法和剑统治，
冒险者们为了更大的利益而被征召。

scripts.text:
[Jade]
So are you from
Rune-Midgarts?
What do you think
of our city with its
advanced technology
and economy? Huh...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
所以你是来自卢恩·米德加兹的吗？
你觉得我们这个拥有先进技术和经济的城市怎么样？
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Jade]
Someday, I'd like
to go visit the land
where you came from.
It sounds so fantastic
and romantic in a way...
scripts.translation:
[杰德]
总有一天，我想去你来的地方看看。
听起来既奇妙又浪漫……

scripts.text:
[Khramptd]
The land around here
is some pretty expensive
property. Yes, it's perfect
for building my awesome palace!
I don't have enough funds at the
moment, but the day will come~
scripts.translation:
[克拉姆普特]
这片土地是非常昂贵的地产。
是的，非常适合建造我宏伟的宫殿！
虽然我目前资金不足，但那一天总会到来的~

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
Sure, I sell a lot
of flowers here, but
the lease that this city
makes me pay cuts into
my profits. It's almost not
worth renting this property.
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
当然，我在这里卖了很多花，
但这座城市收取的租金削减了我的利润。
租这个店面几乎不值得。

scripts.text:
[Maggie]
I pay such a ridiculous
amount for the lease and the
laws here won't let me raise
the price of my flowers. Why
are the city officials so greedy?
scripts.translation:
[玛姬]
我支付了荒谬的高额租金，
而这里的法律又不允许我提高花的价格。
为什么市政官员这么贪婪？

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
......
That lady, working
for that one company,
Kafra, Mafra or whatever.
She certainly is very charming.
scripts.translation:
[华莱士]
......
那位女士，为那家公司工作的，
卡普拉、马夫拉什么的。
她确实很有魅力。

scripts.text:
[Wallace]
Now, if I were
thirty years younger...
Wait! I'm a rich and powerful
man. I could ask her out now.
Hm? What's that look for?
scripts.translation:
[华莱士]
现在，如果我年轻三十岁……
等等！我是个有钱有势的人。
我现在就可以约她出去。
嗯？你那是什么表情？

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
Would you like to
make a donation
to help the hungry?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你好年轻人~
你想捐款帮助饥饿的人吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Now, you can donate 1 to
30,000 zeny that will be used
to support the poor and feed
starving children. If you wish
to cancel, please enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
现在，你可以捐赠1到30,000泽尼，用于支持穷人和喂养饥饿的儿童。
如果你想取消，请输入“0”。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Please enter a value
from 1 to 30,000 in
order to make a donation
to the needy, youngster.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
请输入1到30,000之间的数值以向有需要的人捐款，年轻人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
How disappointing,
but I'm sure you have
your reasons. Well, when
you can afford to give to
the needy, you're welcome
to come back at any time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
真令人失望，
但我相信你有你的理由。
好吧，当你能负担得起给有需要的人捐款时，
欢迎随时回来。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Thank you so much
for your {0} zeny donation.
I promise that your money
will be put to good use in
benefiting the poor and needy.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
非常感谢你捐赠的{0}泽尼。
我保证你的钱会被妥善使用，造福贫困和有需要的人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Still, I'm just a little
disappointed. An adventurer
like you should be donating
as much as you possibly can...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
不过，我还是有点失望。
像你这样的冒险者应该尽可能多地捐款……

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
So far, I've received
a total of {0} zeny in
donations. I'm glad to see
that there are still kind and
generous people in the world.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
到目前为止，我总共收到了{0}泽尼的捐款。
很高兴看到世界上仍有善良慷慨的人。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
This should be enough
to send to the Poor Relief
Organization. Please accept
this small gift as a token of
my gratitude, adventurer. Bless
you, youngster and take care.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
这应该足够寄给贫困救济组织了。
请接受这份小礼物作为我感激的象征，冒险者。
祝福你，年轻人，保重。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
I understand. Still,
keep in mind that when
you give from your heart,
you will be rewarded tenfold.
Though I admit, the benefits
aren't always readily apparent.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
我明白了。
不过请记住，当你用心给予时，你将获得十倍的回报。
虽然我承认，好处并不总是显而易见的。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
Hello youngster~
You seem to be fairly
well-off. Money is good
to have, but be careful not
to become obsessed with it.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
你好年轻人~
你看起来相当富裕。
有钱是好事，但要小心不要沉迷其中。

scripts.text:
[Lucius]
When you have the chance,
please show your generosity
towards others who may be
much less fortunate than you.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯]
当你有机会时，
请对那些比你不幸得多的人表现出慷慨。

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
Sure, manliness is quite
attractive, but I think women
appreciate a guy who could
sympathize and talk with them
a little more. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[拉库梅特]
当然，男子气概很有吸引力，
但我认为女性更喜欢能同情并与她们交谈的男人。
你不同意吗？

scripts.text:
[Laqumet]
I might not be like Sefith,
but I guess I've got a cute
smile, a good personality and
I'm a dandy to boot. Hopefully,
my honesty and loyalty will
help me find someone good.
scripts.translation:
[拉库梅特]
我可能不像塞菲斯那样，
但我想我有可爱的笑容，良好的个性，
而且还是个时髦的人。
希望我的诚实和忠诚能帮我找到好人。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you are experiencing
any sort of inconvenience,
please do not hesitate and
let us know right away.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
如果您遇到任何不便，
请不要犹豫，立即告诉我们。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Please use the stairs
at the northern end to
go downstairs so that you
can go to the Front Desk.
Thank you and I hope that
you enjoy your stay here.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
请使用北端的楼梯下楼前往前台。
谢谢您，希望您在这里住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Christopher Michael]
OoooOoh~
Soooo comfortable.
Don't want to wake up.
Don't want to get up.
Ever again. OoOoooh...
scripts.translation:
[克里斯托弗·迈克尔]
噢~~~
太舒服了。
不想醒来。
不想起床。
永远不起。噢~~~...

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
This hotel is nice
and comfortable, but
to be quite frank, the
drinks here are horrible.
They're unfit for drinking
men such as myself.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
这家酒店舒适宜人，
但坦率地说，这里的饮料糟透了。
它们不适合像我这样的饮酒男士。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
If this is the best hotel,
I expect them to provide me
with the best alcohol. When
I stay at a hotel, that's what
I want. To spend the entire
day not being sober.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
如果这是最好的酒店，
我希望他们能提供最好的酒。
当我住酒店时，那就是我想要的。
整天保持清醒是不可能的。

scripts.text:
[Safwat Fahmy]
It looks like that
today I'll be heading
out to the bar again...
I just wish there were
someplace quieter to drink.
scripts.translation:
[萨夫瓦特·法赫米]
看来今天我又要去酒吧了……
我只希望有个更安静的地方喝酒。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
This is the Couple Suite.
A single can also check
in here, but our hotel will
prioritize couples when
assigning this room.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
这是情侣套房。
单人也可以入住，
但我们酒店在分配此房间时会优先考虑情侣。

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
This chair looks
very nice, but it really
chills my bottom. Brr...!
It's a might uncomfortable!
scripts.translation:
[田上]
这把椅子看起来很漂亮，
但它真的让我的屁股发凉。嘶……！
太不舒服了！

scripts.text:
[Tanoue]
You know what the
perfect chair would
be like? It would be
plush and have electronic
massage and heating controls...
scripts.translation:
[田上]
你知道完美的椅子是什么样的吗？
它应该是柔软的，并有电子按摩和加热控制……

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
Aaahhh Oooooh~
It's sooooo comfy~
The air's so fresh and
this couch is so plush...
Why can't home be like this?
scripts.translation:
[本·艾伦]
啊啊噢~~~
太舒服了~
空气如此清新，
沙发如此柔软……
为什么家里不能像这样？

scripts.text:
[Ben Allen]
I've been in those other
hotels and let me tell you,
this place is the best ever.
After a night's sleep over
here, I feel like a new man!
scripts.translation:
[本·艾伦]
我去过其他酒店，让我告诉你，
这里是最好的。
在这里睡一晚后，我感觉焕然一新！

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Oh sweet jiminy...
That Kafra Lady is so hot.
What a body. And those glasses.
I just gotta ask her out somehow.
scripts.translation:
[竖琴]
哦天哪……
那位卡普拉小姐太火辣了。
那身材。还有那眼镜。
我一定要想办法约她出去。

scripts.text:
[Harp]
Hm, but what should
I do? A love letter? Naw,
that's kind of outdated.
Argh, I can't think! Just
looking at her makes me feel
so happy! Praise be to Kafra!
scripts.translation:
[竖琴]
嗯，但我该怎么做？情书？不，
那有点过时了。
啊，我想不出来！
只要看着她我就感到快乐！赞美卡普拉！

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
''Hospitality with a smile
and total devotion to your
comfort.'' That's our motto
in the Royal Dragon Hotel.
Please inquire at the front
desk if you wish to check in.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
“微笑待客，全心致力于您的舒适。”
这是皇家龙酒店的座右铭。
如需办理入住，请向前台咨询。

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
Welcome to the
Royal Dragon Hotel Bar.
How about a nice night
cap before going to bed?
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
欢迎来到皇家龙酒店酒吧。
睡前喝一杯不错的晚安酒怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Hotel Employee]
If you're looking
for a friend, you
can almost always
make one in this bar.
Alcohol certainly is the
grease for social gears.
scripts.translation:
[酒店员工]
如果你在找朋友，
你几乎总能在酒吧里交到一个。
酒精确实是社交的润滑剂。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Oh yeah. I love-love-love
bars. If I don't come here
for the booze, then I'm here
for all these beautiful ladies.
scripts.translation:
[八]
哦耶。我爱爱爱酒吧。
如果我不是来喝酒，
那就是来看这些美女的。

scripts.text:
[Hachi]
Weird. It's the very first
time I've tried this place's
rum, but doesn't it taste like
pure sexiness to you? Huh...
Oh well, back to schmoozin'
with all the hot chicks~
scripts.translation:
[八]
奇怪。这是我第一次尝试这里的朗姆酒，
但你不觉得它尝起来纯粹是性感吗？
嗯……
哦好吧，回去和辣妹们聊天吧~

scripts.text:
[Duff]
Hey, you're from
Rune-Midgarts, right?
Please make yourself
at home while you're here
in Lighthalzen and have
yourself a good time.
scripts.translation:
[达夫]
嘿，你是来自卢恩·米德加兹的吧？
在里希塔乐镇期间请随意，
玩得开心。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I hate it when guys
just sidle up and sort
of just skip Steps One
and Two. And before you
get all weird, Step Three
is ''Ask for my phone number.''
scripts.translation:
[罗娜]
我讨厌那些家伙
悄悄靠近，直接跳过第一步和第二步。
在你变得怪异之前，第三步是“要我的电话号码”。

scripts.text:
[Rona]
I would just really
appreciate it if one
nice boy would just
talk to me for real.
scripts.translation:
[罗娜]
我真的希望有一个好男孩能真正地和我说话。

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
I don't believe it...
This unlucky streak
will never end, will it?
I lost all my Apples
playing Dice today.
Again. Oh man...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲尔德]
我不敢相信……
这倒霉的运气永远不会结束，是吗？
我今天玩骰子又输掉了所有的苹果。
又是这样。哦天……

scripts.text:
[Greenfield]
Okay. Okay.
If I just keep
playing, eventually
I'll win. I mean, that's
the way the odds work, right?
Even when they're against me...
scripts.translation:
[格林菲尔德]
好吧。好吧。
如果我继续玩，最终我会赢的。
我是说，概率就是这样运作的，对吧？
即使对我不利……

scripts.text:
[Terry]
I'm not big on drinking,
but the atmosphere in this
place is really nice. The
music they play is always
smooth and relaxing...
scripts.translation:
[特里]
我不太喜欢喝酒，
但这里的气氛真的很好。
他们播放的音乐总是平滑而放松……

scripts.text:
[Terry]
Yeah, this is a real cozy
joint. I recommend it to
all you tourists, actually.
Now why don't you kick
back and chill with me?
scripts.translation:
[特里]
是的，这是一个真正舒适的地方。
实际上，我向所有游客推荐这里。
现在为什么不和我一起放松一下呢？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
You see that guy?
That guy over there is
always looking at me.
I wonder... Does he want
to ask me out or something?
scripts.translation:
[圣]
你看到那个家伙了吗？
那边的那个家伙总是在看我。
我在想……他是想约我出去还是什么？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, if he does,
shouldn't he have
more guts? Or are 
you boys much more
shy than I think you are?
scripts.translation:
[圣]
好吧，如果是的话，
他不应该更有勇气吗？
还是你们男孩比我想象的更害羞？

scripts.text:
[Sei]
Well, he is sort of
cute. Geez, this would
be so much easier if he
would just come up and
start talking to me...
scripts.translation:
[圣]
好吧，他有点可爱。
天哪，如果他走过来和我说话，
这会容易得多……

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Isn't the weather nice
today? All this sunlight
will dry these clothes
quickly and give them
a fresh, lovely scent.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
今天天气不错吧？
所有这些阳光会很快晾干这些衣服，
并赋予它们清新可爱的香气。

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, an adventurer from
Rune-Midgarts, are you?
How do you like our city?
If you have any questions,
feel free to ask me anything.
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，你是来自卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者吗？
你觉得我们的城市怎么样？
如果你有任何问题，随时问我。

scripts.text: Well, I have nothing to ask...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没什么要问的……

scripts.text: Any news or rumors?
scripts.translation: 有什么新闻或谣言吗？

scripts.text: I like laundry too.
scripts.translation: 我也喜欢洗衣服。

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, really?
Well, if you've traveled
all over the world, maybe
you've found a place just
like Lighthalzen, so maybe
you're already comfortable?
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，真的吗？
好吧，如果你环游世界，
也许你找到了一个像里希塔乐镇一样的地方，
所以你可能已经习惯了？

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Well, things have
been pretty peaceful
for the past few years.
The only rumor floating
around is about some
weird axe murderer...
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
好吧，过去几年一直相当平静。
唯一流传的谣言是关于某个奇怪的斧头杀人魔……

scripts.text:
[Merpi]
Oh, that's wonderful!
I so love doing hand
laundry, though I'm not
quite sure why. Oh well~
scripts.translation:
[梅尔皮]
哦，太棒了！
我非常喜欢手洗，虽然我不太确定为什么。
哦好吧~

scripts.text:
[Berru]
Daddy...! Waaaaah~!
I wanna see my Daddy!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
爸爸……！哇啊啊~！
我想见爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Berru, I don't 
think Daddy's coming
home tonight. Come on,
we should go to bed.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
贝鲁，我想爸爸今晚不会回家了。
来吧，我们应该去睡觉了。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
No, I'm not gonna
sleep till Daddy gets
home! He said he'll
bring us candy tonight!
You go sleep first, Pilia!
scripts.translation:
[贝鲁]
不，在爸爸回家之前我不会睡觉！
他说今晚会给我们带糖果！
你先去睡吧，皮莉娅！

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Where's our Daddy?
He said he found a
good job, but we haven't
heard from him since then...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
我们的爸爸在哪里？
他说找到了一份好工作，
但从那以后我们就没收到他的消息……

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
What's taking him
so long? I hope Daddy
comes back home soon.
Come on, Berru, don't cry.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
他怎么花了这么长时间？
希望爸爸早点回家。
来吧，贝鲁，别哭了。

scripts.text:
[Berru]
^333333*Sob...*^000000
But I'm hungry
and I miss Daddy!

[Pilia]
Uncle Togii from
next door hasn't
come back either...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
隔壁的托吉叔叔也没回来……

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Hmm? Oh, I'm sorry,
but my little brother
just won't stop crying.
I'm sorry if we're loud...
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
嗯？哦，对不起，
但我弟弟就是停不下来哭。
如果我们吵到你，对不起……

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
Our daddy goes to work
somewhere far away. He
finally has a good job, but
sometimes we don't hear
from him for days. We get
really worried about him.
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
我们的爸爸去很远的地方工作。
他终于有了一份好工作，
但有时我们几天都收不到他的消息。
我们真的很担心他。

scripts.text:
[Pilia]
My brother Berru always
misses him a lot. I don't
know how to make him
stop crying! What do I do?
scripts.translation:
[皮莉娅]
我弟弟贝鲁总是很想他。
我不知道怎么让他停止哭泣！我该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Please...
My child is starving...
Would you give me
some money?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
求求你……
我的孩子快饿死了……
你能给我一些钱吗？

scripts.text: Give him some money.
scripts.translation: 给他一些钱。

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 无视他。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I appreciate your
kindness, but it also
looks like you're in need
of zeny, too. Would you
like to join me?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
感谢你的善意，
但看起来你也缺泽尼。
你想加入我吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here you go,
take this.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
给你，
拿着这个。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Thank you so much.
I have nothing to offer you
in exchange, but I can share
a story with you and impart
some of the wisdom I've
learned over the years.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
非常感谢。
我没有什么可以回报你的，
但我可以和你分享一个故事，
并传授我多年来学到的一些智慧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Everyone's been in
a situation where you
sometimes you feel that
you have to make a choice
between doing the right thing
and doing what you want, right?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
每个人都曾处于这样一种境地：
有时你觉得必须在做正确的事和做你想做的事之间做出选择，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
You may feel trapped.
Well, let me tell you, when
it comes to a problem, all
the solutions available to
you aren't always obvious.
So just calm down and think.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你可能会感到被困住。
好吧，让我告诉你，当遇到问题时，
所有可用的解决方案并不总是显而易见的。
所以冷静下来思考。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What you can see and
understand might not match
with reality. Like the stars that are always there, but not visible
during the day, we'll always have hope, even if we can't see it.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
你能看到和理解的可能与现实不符。
就像星星一直存在，但在白天看不见一样，
即使我们看不见，希望也总是存在的。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Hmm...?
You seem surprised~
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
嗯……？
你看起来很惊讶~

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
I sort of believe in fate and
sort of don't. Let me explain
it this way. I take life day by
day, with each day covering its
own spectrum with miracle on one end and tragedy on the other.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
我有点相信命运，也有点不信。
让我这样解释。我一天天过日子，
每一天都覆盖着一个光谱，一端是奇迹，另一端是悲剧。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
So each day has the capacity
for experiences that can be
good, bad or both. I believe
each person can take an 
active role in shaping their
destiny, day by day.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
所以每一天都有可能经历好、坏或两者兼有的事情。
我相信每个人都可以积极地在塑造自己的命运中发挥作用，日复一日。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Now, there may be certain
things that you can't control,
but even a pessimist might
be able to agree that this
is a world that not only has
tragedy, but miracles as well.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
现在，可能有些事情是你无法控制的，
但即使是悲观主义者也可能同意，
这个世界不仅有悲剧，也有奇迹。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Stand up when you're down
and live your life with passion. The capacity for miracles will
always be there and know that
you can be someone else's
miracle. Isn't that wonderful?
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
跌倒时站起来，充满激情地生活。
奇迹的能力将永远存在，
要知道你可以成为别人的奇迹。
这不是很美妙吗？

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't believe me?
Well, you'll see for
yourself, youngster.
There's much good in you.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
不相信我？
好吧，你会亲眼看到的，年轻人。
你身上有很多优点。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Anger. People deal with
it in different ways. Some
suppress it. Some relish it.
Some fear being angry. Now,
to be simple, let's say there
are two kinds of anger.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
愤怒。人们以不同的方式处理它。
有些人压抑它。有些人享受它。
有些人害怕生气。
现在，简单来说，让我们说有两种愤怒。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The first is the kind that
isn't so productive. More of
a frustration that you can let
go. Someone cut you off on the
freeway or a friend innocently forgot your birthday? No biggie.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第一种是不那么富有成效的。
更多的是一种你可以放下的挫折感。
有人在高速公路上插队，或者朋友无意中忘记了你的生日？没什么大不了的。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Don't let this kind of
anger get to you or you'll
look like a loser. Think of
the big picture and if you're
still upset, vent appropriately. Be honest without hurting anyone.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
不要让这种愤怒影响你，否则你会看起来像个失败者。
想想大局，如果你仍然感到不安，适当地发泄。
诚实而不伤害任何人。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger
is righteous anger. You've
been wronged and need 
some form of retribution. 
Just don't misdirect your anger
and respond appropriately.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二种愤怒是义愤。
你受到了委屈，需要某种形式的报复。
只是不要误导你的愤怒，并适当回应。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
The second kind of anger is
righteous anger. You've been
wronged and need some form
of retribution. Remember to
make appropriate confrontations
and don't misdirect your rage.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
第二种愤怒是义愤。
你受到了委屈，需要某种形式的报复。
记住要进行适当的对抗，不要误导你的愤怒。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
Getting into a fight with
righteous anger, say to protect
someone dear to you, will make
you a hero. Fighting with anger
born of frustration will make you a bully. Know the difference.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
带着义愤去战斗，比如为了保护对你重要的人，会让你成为英雄。
带着因挫折而产生的愤怒去战斗会让你成为恶霸。
知道其中的区别。

scripts.text:
[Beggar]
What's wrong?
It might be a lot
to take in, I know.
scripts.translation:
[乞丐]
怎么了？
我知道这可能有点难以接受。

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Someday...
Someday I just gotta
become a train conductor
and just get outta here!
I really hate this place!
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]
总有一天……
总有一天我一定要成为火车司机，
然后离开这里！
我真的很讨厌这个地方！

scripts.text:
[Reuben]]
Wh-whoa...!
Did you just hear
me talk to myself?
Crud! Don't be so nosy!
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]]
哇-哇……！
你刚才听到我自言自语了吗？
糟糕！别这么多管闲事！

scripts.text:
[Reuben]
Hey. What are
you doing just
looking at me?
I don't know you
from Adam, so get lost~
scripts.translation:
[鲁本]
嘿。你盯着我看什么？
我不认识你，走开~

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
Am I just getting
paranoid? I really
think that some of
the people I know
are disappearing
for no good reason!
scripts.translation:
[圣文]
是我多疑了吗？
我真的觉得我认识的一些人
无缘无故地消失了！

scripts.text:
[Shengwen]
I mean, all of my close
friends are all alright,
but I'm starting not to see
certain acquaintances and
familiar faces. Maybe I'm
just thinking too much...
scripts.translation:
[圣文]
我是说，我所有的亲密朋友都没事，
但我开始看不到某些熟人和熟悉的面孔。
也许我想太多了……

scripts.text:
[Shayna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Oh, you poor
darling girl...

[Cenku Dekdam]
Man, if you were
gonna take this whole
city and then sell it, what
do you think Lighthalzen's
price tag would be, eh?
scripts.translation:
[岑库·德克丹]
伙计，如果你要把整座城市卖掉，
你认为里希塔乐镇的标价会是多少，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Cenku Dekdam]
I mean, this city
is basically just made
of money. Money is what
makes this city such a nice
and pleasant place to live.
scripts.translation:
[岑库·德克丹]
我是说，这座城市基本上就是由钱组成的。
钱是让这座城市成为宜居的美好地方的原因。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
Greetings, adventurer.
I'm Angela, a social
worker for the Poor
Relief Organization.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
你好，冒险者。
我是安吉拉，贫困救济组织的社会工作者。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've noticed that the
people living here have
extremely bad health and
it's not just because of
their circumstances.
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我注意到住在这里的人健康状况极差，
这不仅仅是因为他们的处境。

scripts.text:
[Angela]
I've filed a report
to my superiors, but
they haven't sent me
a response yet for some
reason. I'm starting to get
a little worried about this...
scripts.translation:
[安吉拉]
我已经向上级提交了报告，
但出于某种原因，他们还没有回复我。
我开始有点担心了……

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Must work...
Must focus...
Resist sleepiness...
Why do I keep coming
here? Ugh, h-horrible.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
必须工作……
必须集中注意力……
抵抗睡意……
为什么我总是来这里？呃，太可怕了。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Hey youngster. You wanted
adventuring advice? Okay.
Um. Hm. Always. Brush.
Your teeth. Brush them
everyday. Oh, and don't
forget to floss, either.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
嘿年轻人。你想要冒险建议吗？好的。
嗯。哼。总是。刷。牙。每天刷牙。
哦，也别忘了用牙线。

scripts.text:
[Bankri Kun]
Now it's time for me
to head back to work.
I'll see you later, kid.
Sorry my advice was so
lame-- I couldn't think of
anything else to tell you.
scripts.translation:
[班克里·昆]
现在我该回去工作了。
回头见，孩子。
抱歉我的建议这么烂——我想不出别的可说了。

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
So, the novel I ordered from
the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom
just recently arrived. It's real good, by the guy who wrote
''Roda Frog Adventure''
years ago. Remember?
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
所以，我从卢恩·米德加兹王国订购的小说最近刚到货。
真的很好，是多年前写《罗达蛙冒险记》的那个人写的。记得吗？

scripts.text:
[Enoz]
Anyway, this new book,
''Where the Red Plant Grows''
is up for the Yggdrasilberry
Award. I... I don't know why
I was compelled to share that
with you. Seriously, I don't...
scripts.translation:
[埃诺兹]
总之，这本新书，《红草生长之地》
正在角逐伊格德拉西尔莓奖。
我……我不知道为什么我要和你分享这个。
真的，我不知道……

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
...

[{0}]
Excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello?

[Ellette]
...Oh! Everyone!
I just completed
another one! Hooray!
scripts.translation:
[艾莱特]
...哦！大家！
我刚完成了一个！万岁！

scripts.text:
[All other Employees]
Wh-what?!
No way, not again!
scripts.translation:
[其他所有员工]
什-什么？！
不可能，又来了！

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
Are you even human?
You must have some
secret for that much
productivity. It's weird...
scripts.translation:
[利卡尔]
你还是人类吗？
你一定有什么秘诀才能有这么高的生产力。
真奇怪……

scripts.text:
[Ellette]
Oh, come on.
Maybe I'm a little
good at this, but there's
no way I can beat Cenku.
scripts.translation:
[艾莱特]
哦，得了吧。
也许我在这方面有点擅长，
但我绝对比不上岑库。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Just out of, oh I dunno,
curiosity, which word do
you like better? ''Uber-Cool''
or ''Reality?'' Pick one~
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
出于，哦我不知道，好奇心，
你更喜欢哪个词？“超级酷”还是“现实？”选一个~

scripts.text: Uber-Cool
scripts.translation: 超级酷

scripts.text: Reality
scripts.translation: 现实

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Oh yeah? Me too!
Yeah, we got the same
outlook on life. If you don't
mind, I'd like to shake
your hand, adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
哦耶？我也是！
是的，我们对生活的看法相同。
如果你不介意，我想和你握手，冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Dowbow Ryuei]
Reality, eh?
Well, I agree that
being realistic has its
perks, I'm more of a dreamer.
scripts.translation:
[道宝 龙英]
现实，嗯？
好吧，我同意现实主义有其好处，
但我更像是一个梦想家。

scripts.text:
[Leekal]
So... Very broke.
Why did I spend so much
money on wine, women and
song? I regret it all, all the
pleasure I've had this month.
Yes, it was too much pleasure.
scripts.translation:
[利卡尔]
所以……非常破产。
为什么我在酒、女人和歌曲上花了这么多钱？
我后悔这个月享受的所有乐趣。
是的，乐趣太多了。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
That's what happens
when you're irresponsible
with your money. You really
should read this ''Anybody
Can Be Rich'' book.
scripts.translation:
[宁霍塞]
这就是你对金钱不负责任的后果。
你真的应该读读这本《任何人都能致富》的书。

scripts.text:
[Ninjose]
At long last, I've finally
bought my own home. You
should invest your money for
your future too! Read this,
''Anybody Can Be Rich!''
It's such a great book!
scripts.translation:
[宁霍塞]
终于，我终于买了自己的房子。
你也应该为你的未来投资！
读读这本，《任何人都能致富！》
这是一本很棒的书！

scripts.text:
[Kejulle Rekenber]
Hm? Sure, my last name
is Rekenber and that's the
same name as our chairman,
but that's just a coincidence.
I'm merely a normal employee.
Yeah, no special treatment...
scripts.translation:
[凯朱勒·雷肯贝尔]
嗯？当然，我的姓是雷肯贝尔，
这和我们的会长同名，
但这只是巧合。
我只是一个普通员工。
是的，没有特殊待遇……

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis man here
is motionless,
and for all intents
and purposes, is
soundly asleep.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这个人一动不动，
实际上，
睡得很沉。^000000

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
What am I doing here?
Waiting for my dream
woman to fall into my lap,
what else does it look like?
scripts.translation:
[约书亚]
我在这里做什么？
等待我的梦中情人落入我的怀抱，
还能看起来像什么？

scripts.text:
[Joshua]
Tall, blond, creamy
complexion and smooth
skin. That's right. Come
right to Joshua, babes.
I got my pheromone spray
on and I'm ready to cruise~
scripts.translation:
[约书亚]
高挑，金发，奶油般的肤色和光滑的皮肤。
没错。来吧，宝贝们，来到约书亚身边。
我喷了费洛蒙喷雾，准备巡航~

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
You know the men in
black suits? Boy, did
I get a scare! They actually
tracked me down to ask me
all these weird questions!
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
你知道那些穿黑西装的人吗？
天哪，我吓坏了！
他们居然追踪到我，问了我所有这些奇怪的问题！

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
They kept wanting to
know if I had ever met
anyone from the Rekenber
Corporation, if I've ever been
Uptown, that sort of thing. They
really scared the crap out of me.
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
他们一直想知道我是否见过雷肯贝尔公司的人，
我是否去过上城区，诸如此类的事情。
他们真的把我吓得够呛。

scripts.text:
[Grinnel]
Man, living in the
slums is such a drag.
Not only is life rough,
but all sorts of people
think they can push you
around. I hate Lighthalzen...
scripts.translation:
[格林内尔]
天哪，住在贫民窟真是一种折磨。
不仅生活艰难，
而且各种各样的人都认为他们可以欺负你。
我讨厌里希塔乐镇……

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Whiskey!
I need me some
hard liquor now!
scripts.translation:
[哈加尔]
威士忌！
我现在需要烈酒！

scripts.text:
[Haggar]
Wha--? I didn't
order this stinkin'
rum! I want a man's
drink! Gimme whiskey!
scripts.translation:
[哈加尔]
什--？我没点这该死的朗姆酒！
我要男人的饮料！给我威士忌！

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey man, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿伙计，我知道这地方是个破店，
差不多快要变成完全的贫民窟了，
但我们自豪地拥有米德加尔特最好的朗姆酒。
是真的~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Hey lady, I know this
joint is a dive, pretty much
on the verge of bein' totally
ghetto, but we're proud to
have the best rum in all of
Midgard. It's true~
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
嘿女士，我知道这地方是个破店，
差不多快要变成完全的贫民窟了，
但我们自豪地拥有米德加尔特最好的朗姆酒。
是真的~

scripts.text:
[Tony]
Just a sip of this
beautiful drink and
you're on top of the
world! But it's best
for helpin' yah relax
and forget your worries.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
只要喝一口这美丽的饮料，
你就站在了世界之巅！
但它最适合帮助你放松和忘记烦恼。

scripts.text:
[Tony]
I don't take to bein'
a poet, but I do know
this. Our rum has the
sweet sweet flavor of
loneliness. You really
oughta try it when you can.
scripts.translation:
[托尼]
我不自认为是诗人，
但我知道这一点。
我们的朗姆酒有着甜蜜孤独的滋味。
你有机会真的应该试试。

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey! Hey you...!
D'you wanna, you
wanna hear me tell
you a joke?! It goes...
Um, it goes like this...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿！嘿你……！
你想，你想听我讲个笑话吗？！
它是……
嗯，它是这样的……

scripts.text:
[Garry]
Hey riddle middle,
the cat and th--
No! No, damn it!
That's a song!
No, wait, that's
not a song either...
scripts.translation:
[加里]
嘿谜语中间，
猫和 th--
不！不，该死！
那是一首歌！
不，等等，那也不是一首歌……

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
*Hiccup* I loooove
this rum! I caught a cold
once and one glass made
it go away! 'Course, I slept
for a week too, but that don't
matter! Pshaw! Science...
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
*打嗝* 我爱爱爱这朗姆酒！
我有一次感冒了，一杯就治好了！
当然，我也睡了一周，但那不重要！
呸！科学……

scripts.text:
[Bonse]
Oh, the flavor is just
so clean, but it's also
got a bit of a kick. I don't
know how to describe it.
Its the taste of happiness?
I'm too drunk to even tell!
scripts.translation:
[邦塞]
哦，味道真干净，
但也有一点劲。
我不知道怎么形容。
是幸福的味道吗？
我醉得连自己都说不清了！

scripts.text:
[Assam]
This place is nice
and usually pretty quiet.
I like to come here after
work, have a drink and just
chat with the bartender.
scripts.translation:
[阿萨姆]
这地方不错，通常也很安静。
我喜欢下班后来这里，
喝一杯，和调酒师聊聊天。

scripts.text:
[Assam]
The rum here is incredibly
good too. It might even be
the best in the world. I dunno
why, but for some reason, its
taste reminds me of teamwork~
scripts.translation:
[阿萨姆]
这里的朗姆酒也特别好。
甚至可能是世界上最好的。
我不知道为什么，但出于某种原因，
它的味道让我想起团队合作~

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
Oh, I'm only here
working as a waitress
to help out my father.
This job is so tiring, but
it's nice to see people so
relaxed and having a good time.
scripts.translation:
[兰科]
哦，我只是在这里做女服务员来帮助我父亲。
这份工作很累人，
但看到人们如此放松和享受时光真好。

scripts.text:
[Lanko]
When I get some time
off, I'm going to explore
Lighthalzen and see all that
there is to see. But for now,
it doesn't look like we've got
any real shortage of drunks...
scripts.translation:
[兰科]
当我有空闲时间时，
我要去探索里希塔乐镇，看看所有值得看的东西。
但现在看来，我们真的不缺醉汉……

scripts.text:
[Enku]
*Sob* I just got
dumped! Yeah, I thought
we were gonna get married,
but obviously I was wrong!
Damn it Sheryline! I loved you!
scripts.translation:
[恩库]
*抽泣* 我刚被甩了！
是的，我以为我们要结婚了，
但显然我错了！
该死的谢琳！我爱你！

scripts.text:
[Enku]
I usually don't care for
drinking, especially stuff
like gin or rum, but today,
this stuff tastes just like
my misery. This is all the
comfort I need, you hear?!
scripts.translation:
[恩库]
我通常不喜欢喝酒，
特别是杜松子酒或朗姆酒之类的，
但今天，这东西尝起来就像我的痛苦。
这就是我需要的安慰，听到了吗？！

scripts.text:
[Linus]
After ten years
of marriage. My
wife divorced me...
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯]
结婚十年后。
我妻子和我离婚了……

scripts.text:
[Linus]
So I guess there's no
place for me but here for
now. I don't know what it is,
but the rum is really good
today. Like, it's the flavor
of relaxing, joyous relief~
scripts.translation:
[莱纳斯]
所以我想现在除了这里我没有其他地方可去了。
我不知道是什么，
但今天的朗姆酒真的很好。
就像，是放松、喜悦解脱的味道~

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
You know, everyone
is different, but I think
humans are similar enough
that we can all meaningfully
connect on some level, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
你知道，每个人都是不同的，
但我认为人类足够相似，
我们可以在某种程度上有意义地联系，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
Sure, a rich person might
have different problems than
a poor person, but the point
is, they've both got problems!
Pain, pleasure, sadness, joy.
Those link us all together.
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
当然，富人可能有不同于穷人的问题，
但关键是，他们都有问题！
痛苦、快乐、悲伤、喜悦。
这些将我们所有人联系在一起。

scripts.text:
[Mitchell]
So try not to be picky
about who's your pal and
who's not. We all need
somebody to be with, right?
scripts.translation:
[米切尔]
所以尽量不要挑剔谁是你的朋友，谁不是。
我们都需要有人陪伴，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Dique]
One of the things I look
forward to during my day
is the drink I enjoy right
after work. It's the most
relaxing thing in the world.
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
我每天期待的事情之一
就是下班后享受的那杯酒。
这是世界上最放松的事情。

scripts.text:
[Dique]
Of course, there's
more to life than just
hanging out in pubs and
bars. The thing is, in my
case, pubs and bars are
all I happen to need~
scripts.translation:
[迪克]
当然，生活不仅仅是泡在酒吧里。
问题是，在我的情况下，
酒吧就是我所需的一切~

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
Do you know who I am?!
Just look at this peg leg.
I was in the Comodo War,
Ski Troop division! I lost my
leg to earn your freedom!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
你知道我是谁吗？！
看看这条假腿。
我在克魔岛战争中，
滑雪部队！
我失去了腿才换来你的自由！

scripts.text:
[Loudmouth]
H-hey! What's that
look for? What, you
don't believe me?!
scripts.translation:
[大嘴巴]
嘿-嘿！那是什么表情？
什么，你不相信我？！

scripts.text:
[Guard]
This is a
restricted area.
Please keep clear
if you do not have
special authorization.
Thank you for your cooperating.
scripts.translation:
[卫兵]
这是
限制区域。
如果没有
特别授权，
请保持距离。
感谢您的合作。

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh phooey.
The same customers
are always coming in,
day after day. Can it
get any less exciting?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
哦真倒霉。
同样的顾客总是进来，
日复一日。
还能更不刺激吗？

scripts.text:
[Lasoei]
Oh...!
W-welcome~
C-can I help you
with anything?
scripts.translation:
[拉索埃]
哦……！
欢-欢迎~
我-我能帮你
做些什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Geonuii]
Greetings. This path
leads to the Library and
the Laboratory. Please be
aware that these places
are restricted from access
by the general public.
scripts.translation:
[格奴伊]
你好。这条路通向图书馆和实验室。
请注意，这些地方不对公众开放。

scripts.text:
[Bonnie]
Oh no...
Where did I put it?
scripts.translation:
[邦妮]
哦不……
我把它放哪了？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
^3355FF(Whoa, it's a member
of the staff!)^000000 Good day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
^3355FF(哇，是工作人员！)^000000 你好！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This is a restricted
area! Please show
some ID immediately!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
这是限制区域！
请立即出示身份证件！

scripts.text: ID?
scripts.translation: 身份证？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
I don't know how you
adventurers do things in
Rune-Midgarts, but over here
we have laws about trespassing!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
我不知道你们冒险者在卢恩·米德加兹是怎么做事的，
但在这里我们有非法入侵的法律！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Unless you have special
authorization, nobody is
allowed into the Underground
Laboratory for security reasons.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
除非你有特别授权，
否则出于安全原因，任何人都不允许进入地下实验室。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
Keep your eyes open.
I've heard rumors that some
adventurers from Rune-Midgarts
are trying to sneak into here!
I know the security here is
pretty much fail sure, but...
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
睁大眼睛。
我听说有谣言说一些来自卢恩·米德加兹的冒险者正试图潜入这里！
我知道这里的安全几乎是万无一失的，但是……

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard]
This area is restricted
to the public! Who are you
and how did you get in here?!
Hey, I need backup right away!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵]
此区域不对公众开放！
你是谁，你怎么进来的？！
嘿，我需要立即支援！

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
No wonder these things
break all the time! These
machines have been totally
abused! Ugh, there's no
appreciation for all of this
convenient technology...
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
难怪这些东西总是坏！
这些机器被彻底滥用了！
呃，人们对所有这些便利的技术毫无感激之情……

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Yeah, all of this lab
equipment is really sensitive,
not to mention expensive. If
you ever handle this stuff, you
need to be extra cautious.
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
是的，所有这些实验室设备都非常敏感，
更不用说昂贵了。
如果你 ever 处理这些东西，
你需要格外小心。

scripts.text:
[Repairman]
Hey, you don't work--
G-guards! Hurry! There's
somebody over here!
scripts.translation:
[修理工]
嘿，你不工作--
卫-卫兵！快点！
这里有人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace the other test
tube over here and then
clean the first test tube?
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好吧。从机器里拿出一个试管，
把另一个试管换到这里，
然后清洗第一个试管？

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Or do I clean the test tube,
put it into the machine and
then replace the other one?
I'm so confused with this
procedure! If only I didn't
lose the instructions...
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
还是我先清洗试管，
把它放进机器，
然后替换另一个？
我对这个程序感到困惑！
要是我没弄丢说明书就好了……

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Alright. Pull one test
tube out of the machine,
replace th--hey. You're
not Ralphie. Wait. Guaaards!
Help me, there's some weirdo!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
好吧。从机器里拿出一个试管，
替换 th--嘿。你不是拉尔菲。
等等。卫-卫兵！
帮帮我，这里有个怪人！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Whoa whoa~!
Please! Don't
touch anything!
I'm dealing with highly
volatile chemicals here!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
哇哇~！
请！不要
碰任何东西！
我在这里处理高度挥发性化学品！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
Guards! Hurry,
there's someone
here, and I think
it's one of those crazy
stalkers! Why, why me?!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
卫兵！快点，
这里有人，
我想是那些疯狂的跟踪狂之一！
为什么，为什么是我？！

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

The chairs here are
so not ergonomic. And
they're uncomfortable too!
But it's sooo cool inside this
bank and I just wanted to get
get away from all this heat...
scripts.translation:
[亚瑟]
这里的椅子一点也不符合人体工程学。
而且也不舒服！
但银行里面太凉爽了，
我只是想避开所有这些热量……

scripts.text:
[Helen]
You know, maybe when
I grow up, I'll be a bank
clerk. That sounds like a
really nice job, don't you
think? It's laid back and posh...
scripts.translation:
[海伦]
你知道，也许等我长大了，
我会成为一名银行职员。
那听起来是一份很好的工作，你不觉得吗？
轻松又高雅……

scripts.text:
[Tadem]
I do so enjoy the
architectural structure
of this bank. It's quite
artistic with both classical
and modern elements. Would
you not agree? Fascinating...
scripts.translation:
[塔德姆]
我非常喜欢这家银行的建筑结构。
它兼具古典和现代元素，非常有艺术感。
你不同意吗？迷人……

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
Oh, it's so comfortable
in here~ Though, why are
we inside the bank when
the bank services aren't even
working? Yes, we're standing,
but we're doing it in comfort.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
哦，这里真舒服~
不过，为什么我们在银行里，
而银行服务甚至没有运作？
是的，我们站着，但我们站得很舒服。

scripts.text:
[Gracie]
In fact, it's so
comfortable here,
I think I'll refuse to leave.
Though, I'm willing to change
my mind if you can find a place
that's even more comfortable.
scripts.translation:
[格蕾西]
事实上，这里太舒服了，
我想我会拒绝离开。
不过，如果你能找到一个更舒适的地方，
我愿意改变主意。

errors, all of the bank services
have been temporarily stopped.
We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding.

由于一些关键系统错误，
所有银行服务已暂时停止。
我们对造成的任何不便表示歉意，
并感谢您的理解。

咕噜噜噜！别烦我！

 meh heh heh...

wrong! I'm innocent!

scripts.translation:

What's wrong with
drinking and singing

a beautiful tenor voice?!
Get me outta this joint!
scripts.translation:

在街上喝酒唱歌有什么错，嗯？
拥有美丽的男高音嗓音是犯罪吗？！
把我从这个地方放出去！

scripts.translation:

承认是你干的！！

you I'm not guilty!
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

^333333*Sigh...*^000000

[Suspect]

time. Just let me go.
scripts.translation:

你在浪费时间。
放我走。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
So...
How's your mother?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
那么……
你母亲怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
That's none of
your business!
She's fine, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
这不关你的事！
我想她还好。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
When was the last
time you've seen her?
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
你上次见到她是什么时候？

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
I just told you,
that's none of
your business...!
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
我刚告诉你，
这不关你的事……！

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
You know, mothers
throughout the animal
kingdom instinctively
care for their young.
Humans are no exception.
Yours must be worried to death.
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
你知道，在整个动物王国中，
母亲本能地照顾她们的幼崽。
人类也不例外。
你的母亲一定担心得要死。

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
...
Man...
You're starting
to weird me out.
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
...
伙计……
你开始让我
感到不安了。

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
Funny thing about humans,
though. It seems to be their
nature to lie, even when they
know they'll be caught. But
like all animals, they
instinctively fear pain...
scripts.translation:
[郭警官]
不过，人类有趣的地方在于。
似乎他们的本性就是撒谎，即使他们知道自己会被抓住。
但像所有动物一样，他们本能地害怕痛苦……

scripts.text:
[Suspect]
N-no, no...
You gotta be...
You're bluffing.
Right?
scripts.translation:
[嫌疑人]
不-不，不……
你一定是在……
你在虚张声势。
对吧？

scripts.text:
[Officer Guo]
NO.
You're bluffing.
Tell me...!
TELL ME...!!

scripts.translation:

不。
是你在虚张声势。

承认是你干的！！

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
This Banquet Hall is used
to hold events such as dinner
parties with partners, clients
and other associates, and press
conferences. Of course, there's
nothing going on right now.
scripts.translation:
[宴会工作人员]
这个宴会厅用于举办活动，
如与合作伙伴、客户和其他关联方的晚宴，
以及新闻发布会。
当然，现在这里没有任何活动。

scripts.text:
[Banquet Staff]
Sometimes peace and quiet
is a welcome change of pace,
but right now I'm feeling quite
bored. I think I would rather
be busy than twiddling my
thumbs, to tell the truth.
scripts.translation:
[宴会工作人员]
有时和平与安静是一种受欢迎的节奏变化，
但现在我感到相当无聊。
说实话，我宁愿忙碌而不是无所事事。

scripts.text:
[Luccet]
Shhhh! Hey, my brother's
''it,'' so I gotta find a place
to hide! Wait, would you just
stand really still? I could
just hide behind you! No?
Nuts! Olly olly oxen free!
scripts.translation:
[卢塞特]
嘘！嘿，我哥哥是“鬼”，
所以我得找个地方躲起来！
等等，你就站着别动好吗？
我可以躲在你后面！不行？
讨厌！奥利奥利奥克森自由！

scripts.text:
[Hanccet]
Man... I hate being ''it!''
I'm horrible at this game!
Alright, okay, if I were my
sister Luccet, where would
I think I would not look for
me? Of course...! The sewers!
scripts.translation:
[汉塞特]
天哪……我讨厌当“鬼”！
我玩这个游戏很烂！
好吧，好吧，如果我是我妹妹卢塞特，
我会认为我不会在哪里找我？
当然……！下水道！

scripts.text:
[Annette]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Banquet Hall
is also used to hold weddings.
That must be so wonderful~
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
我听说雷肯贝尔宴会厅也用于举行婚礼。
那一定太棒了~

scripts.text:
[Annette]
Even if it is more expensive,
I'd want to have my wedding
here. Marriage is only once
in a lifetime, ideally, so I'd
want to make mine the most
memorable experience.
scripts.translation:
[安妮特]
即使更贵，
我也想在这里举行婚礼。
婚姻一生只有一次，理想情况下，
所以我想让它成为最难忘的体验。

love love chocolate!
scripts.translation:
[马雷斯]
哟吼吼~
哦，我多么爱爱爱巧克力！

scripts.text:
[Mareth]
Eat it up...

scripts.translation:
[马雷斯]
吃掉它……
或者只是融化它。
把它涂满我全身。
好耶。新的人生目标。

scripts.text:

Jorje seems so cranky

scripts.translation:

不和任何人一起吃饭时，

这房子太大了……
对于一个普通大小的家庭来说显然太大了。
而且我要花很长时间才能确保它保持清洁！

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Jane]
It's not easy keeping
things neat and tidy when
you're responsible for acres
of indoor living space. Being
a maid can be pretty hard...
scripts.translation:
[女仆 简]
当你负责数英亩的室内生活空间时，
保持整洁并不容易。
做女仆可能很难……

scripts.text:
[Housemaid Brenda]
I better dust extra
gently around this vase.
It's worth ten million zeny
and if it were to-- No. No!
I'm not even going to think it!
scripts.translation:
[女仆 布伦达]
我最好在这个花瓶周围轻轻除尘。
它价值一千万泽尼，
如果它--不。不！
我甚至不去想它！

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Down there, the repairman
is just finishing maintenance
on our chairman's private
Airship. Can you imagine
having one of those of your
very own to fly around in?
scripts.translation:
[贝纳图斯]
在下面，修理工刚刚完成对我们会长私人飞空艇的维护。
你能想象拥有一架属于自己的飞空艇到处飞吗？

scripts.text:
[Benatuth]
Yeah, the chairman of
the Rekenber Corporation...
He's a really powerful person.
It's almost scary what he can
do with his money, you know?
scripts.translation:
[贝纳图斯]
是的，雷肯贝尔公司的会长……
他是一个非常有权势的人。
他用钱能做的事情几乎令人恐惧，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Dude, check it out~
Official glossy photos
of the Kafra Ladies. Now...
With 20% more garter belts!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
伙计，看看这个~
卡普拉小姐的官方 glossy 照片。
现在……吊袜带增加了20%！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
So they're all wearing
garter belts in these?
Whoa, that means they
even got the glasses chick
to wear 'em too? That's the
best news I've heard all day!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
所以她们都戴着吊袜带？
哇，这意味着连那个戴眼镜的家伙也戴了？
这是我今天听到的最好的消息！

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Okay man, you know these
are limited edition collector's
items, so each one is worth
300,000 zeny. I mean, I have
an extra set, but I don't know
if you'd wanna buy them off--
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
好吧伙计，你知道这些是限量版收藏品，
所以每一个都值300,000泽尼。
我是说，我有一套多余的，
但我不知道你是否想买--

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
I'll take them all.
Wait, all of them except
for that young kid. Just the
idea of having her glamour
photo around strikes me as...
Yeah. Yeah, it's no good.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
我全都要。
等等，除了那个小孩。
只是想到把她的美照放在身边就让我觉得……
是的。是的，不好。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Whoa, whoa. Now this...
This is art. The lighting,
the angle, the... the...
subject matter. Oh yes.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
哇，哇。现在这个……
这是艺术。光线，角度，……主题。
哦是的。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Drew]
Man, these officially licensed
Kafra Lady glossies... They're
worth every zeny we paid. Say
goodbye Swimsuit Calendar,
and hellooooo Kafra Leilah~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 德鲁]
天哪，这些官方授权的卡普拉小姐 glossy 照片……
它们值我们支付的每一分钱。
再见泳装日历，
你好oooo 卡普拉 莱拉~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Guard Tan]
Leilah? Oh, you mean
the glasses chick? Dude...
Dude. She's my favorite too!
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔卫兵 谭]
莱拉？哦，你是说那个戴眼镜的家伙？
伙计……伙计。她也是我最喜欢的！

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Sometimes the simple
pleasures can give you
the most happiness. For me,
going outside and basking in
the sun is the greatest thing~
scripts.translation:
[黛尔娜]
有时简单的快乐能给你带来最大的幸福。
对我来说，出去沐浴在阳光下是最伟大的事情~

scripts.text:
[Delna]
Yes, sunbathing in a quiet
and relaxing place can be
so refreshing. And if you're
careful about not getting a
sunburn or a tan, a little sun
can be really good for you.
scripts.translation:
[黛尔娜]
是的，在安静放松的地方晒太阳可以让人耳目一新。
如果你小心不要晒伤或晒黑，
一点阳光对你真的很有好处。

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
Curses...
I've come to the
wrong place to seek
out a challenge. No
one here is really all
that mighty or competitive!
scripts.translation:
[武术家]
诅咒……
我来错了地方寻找挑战。
这里没有人真正强大或有竞争力！

scripts.text:
[Martial Artist]
This whole city thinks
it can buy power and safety
with money. They don't know
the value of a nice, friendly
brawl. Hopefully, I'll find a
rival around here soon...
scripts.translation:
[武术家]
整座城市都认为可以用金钱购买权力和安全。
他们不知道一场友好打斗的价值。
希望我很快能在这里找到一个对手……

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
This city might have
more guards and rules
than other places, but
I still don't know if it's
really safe to live here.
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
这座城市可能比其他地方有更多的警卫和规则，
但我仍然不知道住在这里是否真的安全。

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
I mean, the reason we have
these rules is because of all
the unruly gangsters that can
sometimes get into the city.
I mean, it's relatively peaceful and all. But these rules...
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
我是说，我们制定这些规则的原因是因为所有那些有时会进入城市的无序流氓。
我是说，相对和平。但这些规则……

scripts.text:
[Kosit]
It's good to be safe,
but I don't know if it's
a good idea to sacrifice
our freedoms or standard
of living, you know?
scripts.translation:
[科西特]
安全是好事，
但我不知道牺牲我们的自由或生活水平是否是个好主意，
你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Oh, you youngsters.
Always traveling around
and having adventures and
fighting monsters. I certainly
had my fill of excitement back
when I was your age, long ago.
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
哦，你们年轻人。
总是四处旅行，冒险，
与魔物战斗。
当我像你们这么大时，很久以前，
我确实享尽了兴奋。

scripts.text:
[Sopheap]
Sure, I miss doing all
of that, but now I'm content
with just relaxing and resting.
Still, there are a lot of old folk who refuse to sit still like this~
scripts.translation:
[索菲普]
当然，我怀念做那些事，
但现在我满足于只是放松和休息。
不过，有很多老人拒绝像这样坐着不动~

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
Granny may be happy
just sitting around and
enjoying the peaceful life,
but I'm not! I'm too young
to just lay down and let
these days just pass by!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕尔]
奶奶可能很高兴只是坐着享受平静的生活，
但我不！我太年轻了，
不能只是躺下让这些日子流逝！

scripts.text:
[Gopal]
I wanna make something
of myself. Maybe someday,
I'll found a company as big
as the Rekenber Corporation!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕尔]
我想成就一番事业。
也许有一天，
我会创立一家像雷肯贝尔公司一样大的公司！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
Unlike most places,
Lighthalzen has many
beautiful clothing and
accessory shops. This
place is heaven to a
trend-setter like me~!
scripts.translation:
[金米]
与大多数地方不同，
里希塔乐镇有许多漂亮的服装和配饰店。
对于像我这样的潮流引领者来说，这里是天堂~！

scripts.text:
[Kimmy]
I don't know if you
adventurers are interested
in fashion, but you can trash
your old clothes and get some
new, unique and trendy gear
over here in Lighthalzen~
scripts.translation:
[金米]
我不知道你们冒险者是否对时尚感兴趣，
但你们可以扔掉旧衣服，
在里希塔乐镇这里买一些新的、独特的和时尚的装备~

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
Another hungry day...
I don't have any money
and even if I did, there's
no place that sells food
I'd actually eat. Oh, man.
I'm barely living as it is.
scripts.translation:
[博杰]
又一个饥饿的日子……
我没有钱，
即使有钱，也没有地方卖我会吃的食物。
哦，天哪。
我勉强活着。

scripts.text:
[Bodger]
I hear that the people
who live Uptown eat totally
delicious, gourmet food eight
times a day! Hopefully it's just an exaggeration. 'Cuz if it
wasn't, I'd be so mad...
scripts.translation:
[博杰]
我听说住在上城区的人一天吃八次完全美味的美食！
希望这只是夸张。'因为如果不是，我会很生气……

scripts.text:
[Avetis]
A-ack...
^333333*Cough cough*^000000
Would you give me
some m-medicine?!
^333333*Cough cough haack*^000000
Sweet Christmas, it hurts...

[Avetis]
I sk-skipped work
because I've been too
sick t-to go. ^333333*Cough*^000000
But now I don't have
the money to ^333333*Haack*^000000
buy med-medicine...
scripts.translation:
[阿维蒂斯]
我旷-旷工了，
因为我病得太重去不了。^333333*咳嗽*^000000
但现在我没有钱^333333*咳*^000000
买药-药……

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh wow, that weapon
is fantastic! But I'm sure
that it must be really
expensive. Huh...
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦哇，那把武器太棒了！
但我确信它一定很贵。
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ma'am, are you talking
about this Stiletto? You
certainly have an eye for
quality weapons. If you
don't mind me asking,
where are you from?
scripts.translation:
[店员]
女士，你在说这把匕首吗？
你确实有识别优质武器的眼光。
如果你不介意我问，
你来自哪里？

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, I was born
and raised in Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦，我在莫洛克出生和长大。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Ah yes, I've heard many
good things about that town.
You've certainly proven that
people from Morocc truly have
good taste. Now, this Stiletto
is a steal at 39,800 zeny...
scripts.translation:
[店员]
啊是的，我听过很多关于那个城镇的好话。
你确实证明了莫洛克的人真的有很好的品味。
现在，这把匕首只要39,800泽尼就很划算……

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Huh...?!
That's ridiculous!
Never mind that, let
me take a look at that
Gladius in the corner.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
嗯……？！
太荒谬了！
算了，让我看看角落里的那把阔剑。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
The Gladius?
Ah, that would be
39,800 zeny, ma'am.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
阔剑？
啊，那是39,800泽尼，女士。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
Oh, that's a really
good price. I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
哦，价格真的很好。我要了！

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Yes, this replica really
does look just like an
actual Gladius, does it
not? Although not a true
weapon, it's quite capable of
opening the toughest envelopes.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
是的，这个复制品看起来真的就像一把真正的阔剑，不是吗？
虽然不是真正的武器，但它完全能够打开最坚硬的信封。

scripts.text:
[Diana]
...
......
I take that back.
This shop really sucks.
scripts.translation:
[黛安娜]
...
......
我收回那句话。
这家店真烂。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
Welcome to our
store where we offer
many unique products that
you can't find anywhere else.
scripts.translation:
[店员]
欢迎光临我们的商店，
我们提供许多你在其他地方找不到的独特产品。

scripts.text:
[Shop Assistant]
However, shopping is only available to our members. There's an annual
membership fee that's waived when you spend a certain amount every
month in our store. If you invite your friends, you'll receive spe--
scripts.translation:
[店员]
但是，购物仅对我们的会员开放。
每月在我们的商店消费一定金额即可免除年度会员费。
如果你邀请你的朋友，你将获得特--

scripts.text:
[{0}]
N-no thank you!
I'm not interested!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不-不用了！
我没兴趣！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
You know, there's an
interesting story about
the axe that's hanging
over there. Would you
like me to tell you?
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
你知道，那边挂着的斧头有一个有趣的故事。
你想让我告诉你吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
This previous owner of
this Weapon Shop was
a convicted serial killer.
Each night, he'd take that
axe and cruelly murder
beautiful ladies like me.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
这家武器店的前任店主是个被判刑的连环杀手。每到夜晚，他就会拿起那把斧头，残忍地杀害像我这样美丽的女士。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
When he was finally
caught, they beheaded
him with his own axe.
Since then, they say that
his ghost still lingers and
sharpens this axe at night.
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
当他最终被抓获时，人们用他自己的斧头砍下了他的头。从那以后，据说他的幽灵仍然徘徊在此，并在夜间磨快这把斧头。

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Just thinking about
it gives me goosebumps!
And I'm supposed to work
here! It's so creepy!
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
光是想想就让我起鸡皮疙瘩！而且我还得在这里工作！太让人毛骨悚然了！

scripts.text:
[Sergei]
Oh, how disappointing~
It's the perfect story for
the season. Well, now that
I think about it, that story is
actually pretty creepy...
scripts.translation:
[谢尔盖]
哦，真令人失望~
这本来是个应景的完美故事。不过，现在回想起来，那个故事其实挺吓人的……

scripts.text:
[Srinivas]
Those rundown buildings
in the slums are an eyesore
that offend the entire city!
I just wish they would wreck
them down. What do I care
about the poor and needy?
scripts.translation:
[斯里尼瓦斯]
贫民窟里那些破败的建筑真是碍眼，让整个城市都蒙羞！我真希望他们能把那些房子拆掉。我才不在乎那些穷人和 needy 呢？

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
I've heard that the
Rekenber Corporation
actually created the
environment in Lighthalzen
through artificial means.
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
我听说雷肯贝尔公司实际上是通过人工手段创造了里希塔乐镇的环境。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
It seems like it'd take
a lot of investment, but
artificially creating an
environment isn't impossible
with the means available to
the Rekenber Corporation.
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
这似乎需要大量的投资，但凭借雷肯贝尔公司所掌握的手段，人工创造环境并非不可能。

scripts.text:
[Victor Perfecto]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
Still, it's pretty
depressing to think
that the beauty of nature
can be man-made and
equated to zeny, you know?
scripts.translation:
[维克多·佩尔费克托]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
不过，想到自然之美可以被人为制造并与泽尼划上等号，还真是挺让人沮丧的，你说呢？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
The weather is so
nice today, like always.
I just want to ditch work,
run outside and work out.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
今天的天气真好，一如既往。我真想翘班，跑到外面去锻炼一下。

scripts.text: Where do you want to go?
scripts.translation: 你想去哪里？

scripts.text: But shouldn't you go to work?
scripts.translation: 但你不是应该去工作吗？

scripts.text: Have you heard about the serial killer?
scripts.translation: 你听说过连环杀手的事吗？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Well, those guys in
black suits, not to mention
the ruffians that manage to
invade town, sometimes sort
of make it kind of unsafe to
go out all by yourself.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
嗯，那些穿黑西装的家伙，更别提那些设法潜入城镇的流氓了，有时候独自外出确实有点不安全。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
But me and a buddy are
planning to head to the
Al De Baran Turbo Track
one of these days. Boy,
the last time we went,
he wasted a lot of zeny.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
不过我和一个朋友正计划哪天去艾尔帕兰涡轮赛道。唉，上次我们去的时候，他浪费了好多泽尼。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
He actually won some
kind of potion as a prize
and let me have it. I drank
it and it made me move really
slowly. Now what kind of prize
is that supposed to be?!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
他实际上赢得了一种药水作为奖品，并把它给了我。我喝下后，动作变得非常缓慢。这算是什么奖品啊？！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I think my buddy
was totally scammed.
That, or I was totally
tricked by him to drink it.
How they came up with such a ridiculous idea for a prize!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
我觉得我朋友完全被骗了。或者，是我被他彻底 tricked 喝下了那东西。他们怎么会想出这么荒谬的奖品主意！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Wha--?! I didn't say
I was going to ditch work,
I just said I wanted to!
But just to spite you, maybe
just maybe, I won't go today!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
什——？！我没说我要翘班，我只是说我想而已！但为了气你，也许，只是也许，我今天不去了！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Then again, I don't
think I can slack on
this project. Curses...
The weekend certainly
doesn't come fast enough!
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
话说回来，我觉得这个项目我不能偷懒。可恶……周末来得真是太慢了！

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
What, you mean that
axe murderer from a long
time ago? Well, I heard a
rumor that it actually wasn't
like that. Let's see, how
did the story go?
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
什么，你是说很久以前那个斧头杀人犯？嗯，我听到一个谣言，说事实并非如此。让我想想，故事是怎么说来着？

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
I heard that some hat
maker, the one who makes
the Smokie Hat, accidentally
made a Person Headgear
instead of, like, a hat made
of monsters. Don't ask me how.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
我听说有个帽子匠人，就是制作狸猫帽的那位，不小心做成了一个人头饰，而不是怪物做的帽子。别问我怎么做到的。

scripts.text:
[Vergil]
Yeah, I think relatives
of that Airship Captain...
They were totally made into
a hat on accident. Supposedly,
it looks like a Reindeer Head,
but now that's just too weird.
scripts.translation:
[维吉尔]
是的，我想是那位飞空艇船长的亲戚……他们意外地被做成了帽子。据说看起来像驯鹿头，但现在看来那也太奇怪了。

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Arrrgh, I don't
have any time for
talking! I'm in the
middle of an important
task! H-hold on a second!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
啊啊啊，我没时间聊天！我正忙于一项重要的任务！等、等一下！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
D-don't come any
closer! Anyone who
comes near me might
just screw me up! Back off!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
别、别靠近我！任何靠近我的人可能会搞砸我的事！退后！

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
Oh man...
I've been working so
hard and haven't taken
any breaks. I think I'll
reward myself and buy
something like maybe--
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
天哪……
我工作这么努力，一直没休息。我想我该奖励自己，买点东西，比如——

scripts.text:
[Jorje]
No! No, I'm not
gonna buy anything!
I've got my future wife
to think about! Must...
Save... More... Money!
scripts.translation:
[约尔赫]
不！不，我什么都不买！
我还要考虑我未来的妻子！必须……存……更多……钱！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh...!
Good heavens!
Um, may I help you?
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
哦……！
天哪！
呃，有什么我可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
Oh, you're an Assassin!
Oh, you boys are soooo cute!
And so cool and so mysterious all at the same time! I love you!
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
哦，你是个刺客！
哦，你们男孩子太可爱了！
又酷又神秘，同时具备！我爱你！

scripts.text:
[Leimi]
An Assassin...?
Oh, you wouldn't happen
to know any Assassin boys
that might be single, do you?
Oh-my-god, they're hunky-hot~
scripts.translation:
[莱米]
刺客……？
哦，你该不会认识一些单身的刺客男孩吧？
天哪，他们真是性感火辣~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What the...?
That sound. Did...
Did someone just
take my picture?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么……？
那个声音。难道……
难道有人刚刚给我拍了照？

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Welcome to the
temporary headquarters
of Cool Event Corporation.
How may I help you today?
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
欢迎来到酷活动公司的临时总部。
今天有什么可以帮您的吗？

scripts.text: Temporary headquarters?
scripts.translation: 临时总部？

scripts.text: Voting
scripts.translation: 投票

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Our headquarters building
is currently undergoing
reconstruction, so we are
basing our operations in
this place for the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
我们的总部大楼目前正在重建中，因此我们暂时在此处办公。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
目前，卡普拉公司和酷活动公司正在合作开展一项计划，提供直达地下城的瞬间移动服务。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting our valued customers to choose the company they want.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于技术问题，两家公司无法为同一个地下城提供瞬间移动服务。因此，我们将邀请尊贵的客户选择他们想要的公司。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Only a limited number of
voters will be chosen, so
you can check your voting
eligibility at the headquarters
of both participating companies. Thank you for your patronage~
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
只有有限数量的投票者会被选中，因此您可以在两家参与公司的总部查看您的投票资格。感谢您的惠顾~

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Currently, Kafra Corporation
and Cool Event Corp are working
on a collaborative program that
will provide direct teleport
services to dungeons.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
目前，卡普拉公司和酷活动公司正在合作开展一项计划，提供直达地下城的瞬间移动服务。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Due to technical issues,
both companies cannot provide
teleport services to the same
dungeon. Therefore, we will be
selecting a number of valued customers to vote for their choice.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
由于技术问题，两家公司无法为同一个地下城提供瞬间移动服务。因此，我们将选取一定数量的尊贵客户投票选择他们的偏好。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
I've just reviewed your
information and would like
to inform you that you are
indeed eligible to vote.
Your participation in this
election is much appreciated.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
我刚刚查看了您的信息，并通知您确实具备投票资格。非常感谢您参与此次选举。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Remember that the
election polls can be
found in either Prontera
or Juno. Thank you very much.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
请记住，选举投票点位于普隆德拉或朱诺。非常感谢。

scripts.text:
[Saera]
Thank you.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[赛拉]
谢谢。
祝您愉快。

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I don't like this.
But I don't like that
idea either. What will
I do for a new event, eh?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉林]
我不喜欢这个。
但我也不喜欢那个主意。我该做什么新活动呢，嗯？

scripts.text:
[Jellarin]
I need something
major, something that'll
really shake up the world,
something epochal, but what?
Hey, do you have any ideas?
scripts.translation:
[杰拉林]
我需要一些重大的事情，一些能真正震撼世界的事情，一些划时代的事情，但是什么呢？嘿，你有什么想法吗？

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
Hmmm...
The employees seem
to be having too much
fun amongst themselves
recently. This does not
bode well at all...
scripts.translation:
[包托]
嗯……
员工们最近似乎玩得太过开心了。这可不是好兆头……

scripts.text:
[Baoto]
It looks like I'm
just going to have to
start cracking that whip
more often and much
harder. Ha ha ha ha!
scripts.translation:
[包托]
看来我得更加频繁且严厉地挥动鞭子了。哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
Ack! I'm totally
swamped with all this
work! But I don't wanna
do any of it. That's it!
I totally need a break.
scripts.translation:
[塞苏娜]
哎呀！我被这些工作彻底淹没了！但我一点都不想做。就这样吧！我绝对需要休息一下。

scripts.text:
[Cesuna]
^333333*Sigh...*^000000
I wonder if Saera
would ever consider
going out with me?
That would be nice~
scripts.translation:
[塞苏娜]
^333333*叹气...*^000000
不知道赛拉会不会考虑和我约会？那会很美好~

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
Greetings. As part of our
effort to relieve the poor,
Rekenber is providing job
opportunities targeted for
citizens of the slum areas.
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔员工]
您好。作为我们救济穷人努力的一部分，雷肯贝尔正为贫民窟地区的市民提供就业机会。

scripts.text:
[Rekenber Employee]
You can choose to work
from home, or undergo a
little bit of training for more
professional positions. This
is a great chance to make a
difference... and some money~
scripts.translation:
[雷肯贝尔员工]
您可以选择在家工作，或者接受一点培训以胜任更专业的职位。这是一个做出改变……并赚取一些金钱的好机会~

scripts.text:
[A Scientist]
What happened? All the machines are ruined and the research report are gone! The history of Regenschirm has been hacked!
scripts.translation:
[一位科学家]
发生什么事了？所有的机器都坏了，研究报告也不见了！雷根修芦的历史被黑客入侵了！

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
It takes so long for
this device to process
all the data and give me
the results. Still, the wait
heightens my anticipation...
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
这台设备处理所有数据并给出结果需要很长时间。不过，等待也增加了我的期待……

scripts.text:
[Scientist]
What?! Guards!
Hurry, there's an
intruder right here!
scripts.translation:
[科学家]
什么？！卫兵！
快点，这里有入侵者！
